message.content:
For the **PreLicenseTraining.com login**, use the account login page and enter your **login name** and **password**; the site notes your login name may be your **email address** unless you use a different login name.[1]

If you forgot your password, use the **Forgot Password** page and enter the **email address** for the account you’re trying to access to receive reset instructions.[2]

- **Login page:** PreLicenseTraining.com / Account Login.[1]
- **Password reset:** Forgot Password page.[2]
- If you’re using the **PSI Learning Academy / Mentor Portal**, there is a separate mentor password reset page and a separate login link.[4]
